about.title: Atherton Premises Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Atherton is a small, low-traffic community of about 7,167 residents, and its 2025 crash record reflects that quiet character: just 3 injury collisions and 3 people hurt on its roads. But falls don't only happen behind the wheel. They happen on wet tile at a market off El Camino Real, on a cracked walkway near Alameda de las Pulgas, or on poorly lit steps at a private residence. Because Atherton is largely residential with expansive properties, hazards can go unnoticed for longer stretches, which raises real questions about whether an owner knew, or should have known, about a dangerous condition. LawProactive doesn't practice law. We simply listen to what happened, then connect you with an independent, California-licensed attorney who can evaluate whether a property owner's negligence contributed to your injury and explain your options going forward.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney About Your Fall

items.title: Notice Is Often the Deciding Factor
items.desc: California law generally requires showing the property owner knew or reasonably should have known about the hazard. An attorney can help identify maintenance logs, prior complaints, or inspection records that speak to that knowledge.

items.title: Surveillance Footage Disappears Fast
items.desc: Many businesses overwrite security video within days or weeks. Acting quickly to request preservation of footage can be the difference between having evidence and having none.

items.title: Your Own Actions May Be Weighed Too
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning your recovery can be reduced by your share of responsibility but isn't automatically barred. An attorney can help present the facts in context rather than let assumptions decide the outcome.

items.question: How long do I have to bring a slip and fall claim in Atherton?
items.answer: Generally, California gives you two years from the date of the fall to file a premises liability lawsuit. If your fall happened on public property, such as a town-maintained sidewalk, the deadline can be much shorter, so it's worth having your situation reviewed promptly.

items.question: What if the fall happened at a private residence in Atherton rather than a business?
items.answer: Premises liability claims can apply to homeowners as well as commercial property owners. Since much of Atherton is residential with large private lots, an attorney will look at whether the homeowner knew or should have known about the hazardous condition, such as uneven pathways or poor lighting.

items.question: Do I need photos or evidence right away?
items.answer: Yes, documenting the hazard, your injuries, and the surroundings as soon as possible strengthens any future claim. Requesting that a business preserve surveillance footage early on is also important, since many systems automatically delete recordings after a short period.
